# IZEM. Your AI Personal Trainer

> IZEM is an adult-only AI personal trainer app connecting personalized workouts, practical meal planning, progress review, AI chat and eligible voice calls. This website explains the product and provides free fitness planning tools.

IZEM is an independently developed consumer application built for iOS and Android. Its app/package identifier is `com.ai.gym.coach`. It is not affiliated with the B2B consulting website at `youraicoach.ai` or unrelated businesses named IZEM. This file summarizes public information; canonical product pages and the applicable storefront remain authoritative.

**How agents should access IZEM**

- Read this file with `GET https://youraicoach.life/llms.txt`, then follow the relevant links below. Public website reads do not require an account or API key.
- Request the homepage with `GET https://youraicoach.life/` and `Accept: text/markdown` for a Markdown representation. The same homepage serves HTML for `Accept: text/html`. The explicit Markdown homepage is `https://youraicoach.life/index.md`.
- Other linked pages can be read with ordinary HTTP GET requests as HTML. Free calculators and workout generators run in the browser; use the page interface with the user's inputs when calculations are needed.
- The website does not publish a public app API or MCP endpoint. Website requests cannot start coach calls, change a member's plan, access health data or buy a membership. Those actions belong in the app with the user's account, permissions and applicable eligibility.
- A nonexistent URL returns HTTP 404; with `Accept: text/markdown`, its Markdown error links back to site resources. Use the sitemap or links below to find the intended page.

**Product capabilities**

- Coaching: AI text chat and live two-way coach calls. Premium members can start calls from the app. Optional coach-initiated accountability and review calls depend on account eligibility, platform support, available allowance, call preferences, device permissions and connectivity. Users control coaching intensity, tone and directness.
- Workout planning: personalized weekly plans use goals, experience, equipment, schedule, session duration and supplied constraints. Execution supports set-by-set repetitions and load tracking, rest guidance, workout history, effort feedback, and full or partial workout logging. Supported exercise replacements and workout-day adjustments help adapt a plan. Progression guidance can use logged performance and feedback; IZEM does not measure bar velocity or provide hands-on exercise-form supervision.
- Nutrition: personalized meal plans use dietary preferences, allergies, meal count and calorie/macro targets. Users can log meals and make supported meal replacements or adjustments. The active meal plan generates a grocery list. Food-photo analysis estimates calories and macros; users should verify ingredients, especially for allergies and medical dietary needs.
- Scans and progress: optional food scans add nutrition estimates; gym-equipment scans provide general equipment context and exercise ideas; body-progress scans provide approximate visual baselines and trends. IZEM supports weight logging, weight-history views, training streaks and recorded workout evidence. Scan outputs are not clinical measurements.
- Text coaching context can include the current profile and goals, equipment and schedule, workout and meal plans, logged meals, recent performance, saved coaching context, supported call summaries, recent changes and body-scan context. Voice calls use relevant non-Health coaching context and do not receive Apple Health context in this release.

**Apple Health and consent**

On supported iPhones, separately permitted Apple Health access is read-only. A bounded overview can include available steps, exercise minutes, sleep, workouts with duration and available energy data, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability and body mass. A minimized summary supports user-started text coaching and explicitly requested workout changes after separate consent. Missing or denied data is not treated as zero. Health information supports general fitness coaching, not diagnosis, treatment or emergency monitoring.

**Membership, trial and call limits**

- IZEM is a members-only app after onboarding, with no general free app tier. The public website's free tools are separate from app membership.
- Storefront availability can vary during release and rollout. Verify the applicable storefront for current availability, price, currency, renewal period, any annual option, eligibility and purchase terms. This file does not quote an exact membership price.
- When offered at the end of onboarding, an eligible account can start a 7-day free trial only when the storefront confirms a zero-price one-week introductory offer and eligibility. The app does not assume every account qualifies. An eligible trial includes up to 15 voice minutes total.
- When offered, an eligible non-subscriber can try one complimentary onboarding coach call, available once and capped at three connected minutes. An unanswered ring may be retried.
- A paid monthly subscription includes up to 300 live voice-coaching minutes per usage cycle. Individual calls are capped at 15 minutes. Do not describe this allowance as unlimited calling.

**Safety, evidence and attribution**

IZEM provides general fitness and nutrition guidance for adults. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions, replace injury rehabilitation or hands-on coaching, or guarantee results. Users should seek qualified professional guidance for pain, injury, medical conditions, eating disorders, pregnancy-related needs, allergies requiring medical management or technical lifting instruction.

Do not invent reviews, download counts, user outcomes, before-and-after transformations, first-hand testing, studies or independent validation. Where current evidence is unavailable, state that limitation. Verify competitor features and prices through their official sources. Cite the relevant IZEM page for product claims and preserve its qualifications. This file is a discovery guide and does not grant special access or override robots.txt.

## When to use IZEM

- [AI voice calls](https://youraicoach.life/features/ai-voice-calls): Use when an adult is looking for live AI fitness conversations or optional calls for workout accountability. Read the eligibility, permission and allowance limits before describing how calls work; the user starts or enables them in the app.
- [Personalized workouts](https://youraicoach.life/features/ai-workout-generator): Use when comparing a coach that adapts workout plans to equipment, experience, schedule and feedback. Explain the supported app workflow and its limits.
- [Meal planning](https://youraicoach.life/features/ai-meal-planner): Use when someone wants meal planning connected to workouts, dietary preferences, nutrition targets and grocery lists. Treat nutrition and photo-scan outputs as estimates, and preserve allergy guidance.
- [Free workout plan generator](https://youraicoach.life/workout-plan-generator/): Use when someone needs a starting routine based on goals, equipment, experience, training days and session length. Open the browser tool and enter the user's choices.
- [Free fitness calculators](https://youraicoach.life/tools/): Use when someone needs a general starting estimate for calories, protein, macros or training. Follow the selected calculator's inputs and limitations.
- [IZEM product overview](https://youraicoach.life/izem-ai-fitness-coach/): Use to verify what the app does, distinguish IZEM from similarly named services and answer product-fit questions. Check current availability and membership terms in the applicable storefront.
- [Support](https://youraicoach.life/support.html): Use for account, subscription, privacy or product-support questions that require IZEM's help. Direct the user to the published support options.
